record: N9-F6 release-owner binding ruling: cold-gate disposition for the default promotion

decides.record_as_measured_release_limitation: ADOPTED, under the binding conditions below

grounds: The <=3% cold bound is an element of the INHERITED N8 DEFAULT-NATIVE criteria (MEASUREMENT.md 'Positive performance gate': 'geometric mean A/auto >=1.10 ... protected/default/cold regressions <=3%'). Its textual scope is the NATIVE default promotion. Native was terminated NATIVE_LOSS in F3; no native gate is being rewritten, relaxed or re-measured here, and the native closure stands on its own record.

The decision the cold miss now touches is the M-vs-final merge comparison (MERGE_SCOPE 'Merge safety and comparison'), whose fail condition is 'final loses or breaks main behavior'. The measured record: parity bitwise (uint32 sha256) FINAL == MAIN on ALL 6 cells; carried cells 1024-binary 124.1x, 1024-mix 2.17x, 128-binary 1.69x, 128-mix 1.54x (MARGINAL); declined all-raw cells FASTER than main (0.667 ratio; per-pair median 1.48-1.52x); geomean 5.14x median-of-times. Final does not lose the comparison; the single miss is a one-time cold metric.

Mechanism is bounded and one-time: +209.6 ms per cold process (2695.349 vs 2485.726 ms, cell B=1024 mix), the marginal njit compile cost of the added default route. main is likewise JIT-dominated at cold (main cold/warm = 384.78x; final cold/warm = 760.26x) - the delta is 'more functionality compiles once', not a pathological steady-state regression.

Payback is quantifiable where it matters: at the 1024-mix cell the steady-state saving is ~2.9 ms per invocation (main warm ~6.46 ms vs final warm ~3.55 ms, derived from the recorded cold/warm ratios), so the one-time +209 ms is repaid within the first ~72 longwave invocations of a 1024-class run - inside the first seconds of any real 24-48-step multi-tile workload, and far faster at 1024-binary (123x). HONESTY LABEL: for small single-tile 128-class runs the one-time cost is proportionally larger and may not repay within a short run; that residual is accepted and disclosed, not argued away.

A mitigation pass now (bounded default NUMBA_CACHE_DIR under the user cache dir) is a NEW behavior change: a new writable location with new failure modes (read-only HOME, concurrent processes, cache corruption handling) and its own DX surface. Landing it now changes the dependency closure AFTER F5/F6, invalidating evidence reuse (MEASUREMENT.md: 'Reuse evidence only when the relevant dependency closure is unchanged'), and the campaign's experiment limit is consumed. It is recorded as a named post-release follow-up, NOT a merge condition, NOT shipped in this campaign.

Reverting the default would discard a bitwise-parity, all-cells-winning route over a disclosed one-time cost while the raw guard already protects the only measured steady-state loss class - it would contradict the campaign's own measured record without satisfying any documented rule.
